title: autonomous plan map
lede: Every part of the standards repo, what governs it, where it stands, and what it waits on.
about: The plan of record for `autonomous`, drawn as a map of its own records. It is the first instance of the plan-map kit module (Decision 97), so it is also a test of the format. Every status cites a decision, a ROADMAP row or a file; an edge the records do not state is marked as the plan's inference.

status_meaning.closed: Built, and its gate is recorded as met.
status_meaning.built: Exists and is tested; its gate is not yet recorded as met.
status_meaning.in progress: Work under way, or partly built.
status_meaning.ruled: Ratified by the human; not started.
status_meaning.planned: In ROADMAP; not ratified in detail and not started.
status_meaning.superseded: Replaced by another part before it was done.

inconsistencies: ROADMAP marks Phase C0 (Consolidation) as `← current phase`, but its gate has no recorded result, and every phase opened since 2026-08-17 (K, O, S, A) runs as a parallel track. The roadmap's stated spine, P0 to P4, has not moved since. Raised as a decision: `c0-spine`.
The landscape audit has been live since 2026-07-10 (a monthly cloud routine), yet ROADMAP files it under Deferred / demoted.

The Kit v2 track's `Shipped so far` paragraph is dated 2026-07-10/11 and lists its next items. Since then, kit versions 2.0.0 to 2.10.0 have shipped under Phase K, and the paragraph has not been updated.
T2 asks for a declaration form for project-level items waiting on the human. Decision 90 ruled that form: the decision queue, one file per repo. Raised as a decision: `t2-queue`.

parts.title: Consolidation
parts.what: Pull the ad-hoc corpus into this repo; doctrine single-sourced; pointers wired.
parts.note: ROADMAP still marks this the current phase. Its gate (a clean dedup sweep) has no recorded result; see Inconsistencies.

parts.title: Kit v2 profiles
parts.what: Agent profiles the organ phases consume (organ, watchdog, conductor, verifier, critic, curator).

parts.title: Conductor substrate decision
parts.what: Cron plus headless sessions, a workflow, or a supervisor daemon: decided at P0 entry.

parts.title: Enforcement floor
parts.what: Territory hooks, a HALT sentinel and a deterministic watchdog skeleton.
parts.note: Parts of it now exist under other names: O0.5 gates on the gates, A0 harness-owned actions. The links are the plan's inference.

parts.title: One organ, real loop
parts.what: One organ with ./verify and a merge queue on a toy codebase, unattended shifts.

parts.title: Ledger choice (Beads or minimal)
parts.what: Deferred to P2, when a task ledger is actually needed.

parts.title: Two organs, one seam
parts.what: Contract dir, consumer contract tests, task ledger, generated boundary linter.

parts.title: Memory and curator
parts.what: Leaf loops per organ; audit promote-up; curator down-propagation.

parts.title: Full governor and first real project
parts.what: Coherence critic, metrics dashboard, escalation; a simulated incident caught without a human.

parts.title: Global README-refresh loop
parts.what: A second global agent refreshing READMEs; decide after P3 whether it is the curator generalized.

parts.title: Kit version, declared
parts.what: kit/VERSION, kit_version in manifests, a CHANGELOG whose entries name their retrofit action.

parts.title: /retrofit as a migration
parts.what: /retrofit reads kit_version and applies CHANGELOG entries in order; re-running is a no-op.

parts.title: Uniform intake/ structure
parts.what: intake/ at repo root, one dated drop per subdirectory with a PROVENANCE.md; promoted by explicit act.

parts.title: Session-boundary commands
parts.what: /wakeup, /breakdown, /reorient over a shared state routine and a session registry.
parts.note: Core built 2026-08-18. Gate open: the registry location is not named, and /breakdown does not yet write STATUS.json.

parts.title: Currency audit and fleet catch-up
parts.what: One sweep answers which repos are behind; catch-up in reviewed batches, never a swarm.

parts.title: Fleet routines
parts.what: Daily and weekly coordination: the boards on a cadence first, then sweep, TODO and currency routines.

parts.title: contract_gate in every composite
parts.what: The contract-version check rides kit_integrity in every repo, observing.
parts.note: Gate to deny: Orrery and unified-pm add a version line, Lathe answers on its prose contract field, a clean week.

parts.title: File-restructuring sweep
parts.what: Worktrees, registry, move, venvs, retrofit: a clean layout for the second machine.
rows: The file-restructuring sweep is back on the table

parts.title: Human TODO collector
parts.what: todo_scan.py: one list of everything in the fleet waiting on the human, from signals that already exist.

parts.title: todo.1 schema
parts.what: The list as a contract artifact beside status.1, so consumers render and never re-collect.

parts.title: Project-level TODO declarations
parts.what: A declaration form for per-project items waiting on the human.
parts.note: Decision 90's decision queue (one file per repo) is this declaration form; see Waiting on you.

parts.title: The TODO loop closes
parts.what: An item is done when the human did the thing and the next sweep sees it gone; no checkbox.

parts.title: cites_missing blocks
parts.what: Flip the cites check from reporting to blocking once every open thread carries cites:.

parts.title: S4 freshness and open-PR surfacing
parts.what: Stale research and unmerged audits warn; open PRs here are reported as the human's.

parts.title: Outside and then
parts.what: STATUS.md section: last audit, unconsumed findings, next run.

parts.title: Environment watch
parts.what: The landscape audit's remit covers protocol cadence, platform shifts and provider policy.

parts.title: Algedonic cloud check
parts.what: Weekly deterministic check of what GitHub can see: red CI, public leaks, stranded merges.

parts.title: Landscape audit
parts.what: Monthly cloud routine: a propose-only PR re-surveying the outside world.
rows: Landscape audit (meta-audit of the protocol itself)
basis: R:Landscape audit (meta-audit of the protocol itself)
parts.note: Live since 2026-07-10, but filed under Deferred / demoted in ROADMAP.

parts.title: Hands-off session boundaries
parts.what: Start and end hooks open and close each session's record with its facts.
parts.note: Gate: a week in which every normally exited session closed its own record. Not recorded as met.

parts.title: Gates on the gates
parts.what: Hook self-test, config guard and GATE-CHANGE rule, observing; one central event log.

parts.title: The record says what ran
parts.what: Kit-owned closing gate with a tree fingerprint (observing), verify receipt, landing check.
parts.note: Gate to deny: a week of stop-gate events read with clean/pushed, horde's pilot report, the clean-branch ruling.

parts.title: Oversight engine and snapshot
parts.what: governor/oversight.py: the eleven sync checks and the budget table as findings; a fleet snapshot.

parts.title: Delivery and interrupts
parts.what: One-time in-session lines and notifications on interrupts; gates flip per gate.

parts.title: Setpoint audit and regulator review
parts.what: A weekly three-list diff, silent when empty; a monthly review of thresholds and hooks.

parts.title: Dashboards
parts.what: A standalone app here and the LifeOS fleet page, read-only, empty when healthy.

parts.title: HALT
parts.what: Human-armed per repo; deferred until O2's noise is measured.

parts.title: Run ledger
parts.what: What each dispatch did, written by hooks; cost per dispatch from the telemetry export.

parts.title: Decision queue
parts.what: One small committed file per repo of what waits on the human, and a board over all of them.
parts.note: First instance: this plan's queue.json, read by the map. The cross-repo board is not built.

parts.title: Plan map (opt-in kit module)
parts.what: One parts.json per repo, generated views, headless checks: this map.
parts.note: First instance: autonomous itself, format kit.plan/0 (draft, open to horde's objection).

parts.title: Outward actions through act
parts.what: act push, pr-open, pr-close and batch, each refusal a planted case; merges denied by rule.

parts.title: Observe raw outward calls
parts.what: A global hook logs every raw git push / gh pr call that skipped act; act file for mailbox filings.

parts.title: Deny raw outward calls
parts.what: Each command's raw route denied by its own signed GATE-CHANGE after a clean week.

parts.title: Credential isolation
parts.what: The agent's shell holds no GitHub credential; only act does. Only if A1 shows it is needed.

parts.title: Security catalogue and templates
parts.what: Catalogue schema from horde's row; SECURITY.md and SECURE-PATTERNS.md templates.

parts.title: Security coverage check
parts.what: Observe-first; required where a repo ships binaries or parses untrusted input; parses verify and CI.

parts.title: Guard drills
parts.what: Re-run every guard's planted control on a schedule.

parts.title: Supply chain and settings checklists
parts.what: Checklists and a pentest runbook.

parts.title: Recursive VSM frame
parts.what: What is invariant at every level and what is per level; written from K0–K5's material.

parts.title: Live agent-to-agent messaging
parts.what: Excluded at this scale; revisit only if the task ledger cannot express a needed interaction.
